mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dev_sample_node WHERE tenant_key=#{tenant} AND company_id=#{companyId} AND sample_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dev_sample_node n SET plan_date=v.plan_date,owner_id=v.owner_id,remark=v.remark, update_by=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() FROM (VALUES (CAST(#{i.id} AS bigint),CAST(#{i.planDate} AS date),CAST(#{i.ownerId} AS bigint),CAST(#{i.remark} AS varchar)) ) AS v(id,plan_date,owner_id,remark) WHERE n.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND n.company_id=#{companyId} AND n.sample_order_id=#{orderId} AND n.id=v.id

UPDATE dev_sample_node SET owner_id=#{ownerId},update_by=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_key=#{tenant} AND company_id=#{companyId} AND sample_order_id=#{orderId} AND done_date IS NULL
